newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FOWLER SCORES TWICE AS LIVERPOOL BEAT DERBY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FOWLER SCORES TWICE AS LIVERPOOL BEAT DERBY.

text.p: England striker Robbie Fowler scored twice inside four minutes as Liverpool beat Derby 2-1 on Sunday to go third in the premier league.
Fowler showed typical opportunism two minutes after halftime, following up a parried left-foot drive from Czech Patrick Berger to score his third goal in three games since returning from injury.
In Liverpool's next serious attack Fowler rose above two Derby defenders to meet John Scales's sweetly struck cross with a powerful header into the bottom left-hand corner of Russell Hoult's net.
Mid-table Derby pulled a goal back through Ashley Ward in the closing minutes but the home side never looked like letting the match slip.
"I'm not 100 percent fit yet but I'm getting there," said Fowler, who had to pull out of the England squad for the World Cup qualifier against Poland earlier this month because of an ankle injury.
Liverpool, who have won the English championship a record 18 times, are now a point behind Arsenal, who lead the table on goal difference from Newcastle.
They also have a game in hand on their rivals after torrential rain washed out last weekend's match against Everton.
